format: html
execute:

```{r}
#| label: comparison-data

library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Anne's original pollen counts and modelled ages
anne_raw <- read_excel("pollen counts trettetjorn Anne.xlsx", sheet = "Ark1")

anne_non_sum_columns <- c(
  "Depth, cm", "Age cal yr BP", "Dryopteris-type", "Sphagnum",
  "Unknown", "Botryococcus", "Pediastrum", "Charcoal dust"
)

anne_counts <- anne_raw[
  , !names(anne_raw) %in% anne_non_sum_columns, drop = FALSE
]
anne_counts[] <- lapply(anne_counts, as.numeric)
anne_counts[is.na(anne_counts)] <- 0
anne_main_sum <- rowSums(anne_counts)

anne_compare <- data.frame(
  depth_cm = as.numeric(anne_raw[["Depth, cm"]]),
  age_cal_yr_BP = as.numeric(anne_raw[["Age cal yr BP"]]),
  charcoal = as.numeric(anne_raw[["Charcoal dust"]]),
  Juniperus = 100 * as.numeric(anne_raw[["Juniperus communis"]]) / anne_main_sum,
  Pinus = 100 * as.numeric(anne_raw[["Pinus sylvestris"]]) / anne_main_sum
) |>
  filter(depth_cm <= 30)

anne_loi <- read_excel("Glødetap_Anne.xlsx", sheet = "Sheet2") |>
  transmute(
    depth_cm = as.numeric(`Depth, cm`),
    LOI = as.numeric(`LOI, %`)
  ) |>
  filter(is.finite(depth_cm), is.finite(LOI), depth_cm <= 30)

# Interpolate Anne's ORIGINAL modelled ages for LOI measurements
anne_loi <- anne_loi |>
  mutate(
    age_cal_yr_BP = approx(
      x = anne_compare$depth_cm,
      y = anne_compare$age_cal_yr_BP,
      xout = depth_cm,
      rule = 1
    )$y
  )
```

## TRET25 data

```{r}
#| label: tret-comparison-data

my_count <- read_excel(
  "my samples count done.xlsx",
  sheet = "my count",
  range = "A1:AA67",
  col_names = FALSE
)

sample_names <- as.character(unlist(my_count[1, -1]))
depth_midpoint_spore <- setNames(
  as.numeric(unlist(my_count[3, -1])), sample_names
)
taxon_counts <- as.data.frame(my_count[7:67, -1])
rownames(taxon_counts) <- as.character(unlist(my_count[7:67, 1]))
colnames(taxon_counts) <- sample_names
taxon_counts[] <- lapply(taxon_counts, as.numeric)
taxon_counts[is.na(taxon_counts)] <- 0

all_counts <- as.data.frame(t(taxon_counts))
excluded_from_main_sum <- c(
  "Dryopteris-type", "Sphagnum", "Lycopodium counted", "Unknown"
)
main_pollen_spore_counts <- all_counts[
  , !names(all_counts) %in% excluded_from_main_sum, drop = FALSE
]
pollen_spore_sums <- rowSums(main_pollen_spore_counts)
pollen_spore_percentage <- sweep(
  main_pollen_spore_counts, 1, pollen_spore_sums, "/"
) * 100

pollen_ages <- read.csv("Plum_runs/pollen_sample_ages.csv")
samples <- rownames(main_pollen_spore_counts)

loi_raw <- read_excel("glødetap.xlsx", sheet = "Sheet1") |>
  transmute(
    beaker_nr = as.character(`beaker nr`),
    dry_g = as.numeric(`beaker+dry`) - as.numeric(beaker),
    ash_g = as.numeric(`beaker+burnt`) - as.numeric(beaker)
  ) |>
  mutate(LOI_percent = (dry_g - ash_g) / dry_g * 100)

charcoal_raw <- read_excel("charcoal.xlsx", sheet = "Sheet1") |>
  transmute(
    sample = as.character(sample),
    charcoal_3T = as.numeric(charcoal),
    lycopodium_3T = as.numeric(lycopodium),
    lycopodium_full = as.numeric(`pollen lycopodium`)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    charcoal_adjusted = charcoal_3T * lycopodium_full / lycopodium_3T
  )

my_compare <- data.frame(
  depth_cm = as.numeric(depth_midpoint_spore[samples]),
  age_cal_yr_BP = pollen_ages$median_cal_yr_BP[
    match(samples, as.character(pollen_ages$sample))
  ],
  LOI = loi_raw$LOI_percent[match(samples, loi_raw$beaker_nr)],
  charcoal = charcoal_raw$charcoal_adjusted[
    match(samples, charcoal_raw$sample)
  ],
  Juniperus = as.numeric(pollen_spore_percentage[["Juniperus communis"]]),
  Pinus = as.numeric(pollen_spore_percentage[["Pinus sylvestris"]])
)
```

## Compare the cores by modelled age

```{r}
#| label: fig-anne-comparison
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 9
#| fig-cap: "Core-to-core proxy comparison using Anne's original modelled ages and TRET25 Plum median ages."

anne_long <- bind_rows(
  anne_loi |>
    transmute(age_cal_yr_BP, panel = "Anne LOI", value = LOI),
  anne_compare |>
    transmute(age_cal_yr_BP, panel = "Anne charcoal", value = charcoal),
  anne_compare |>
    transmute(age_cal_yr_BP, panel = "Anne Juniperus", value = Juniperus),
  anne_compare |>
    transmute(age_cal_yr_BP, panel = "Anne Pinus", value = Pinus)
)

my_long <- my_compare |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(LOI, charcoal, Juniperus, Pinus),
    names_to = "proxy",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  mutate(panel = paste("My", proxy)) |>
  select(age_cal_yr_BP, panel, value)

comparison_age <- bind_rows(anne_long, my_long)

comparison_age$panel <- factor(
  comparison_age$panel,
  levels = c(
    "Anne LOI", "My LOI",
    "Anne charcoal", "My charcoal",
    "Anne Juniperus", "My Juniperus",
    "Anne Pinus", "My Pinus"
  )
)

# Shared horizontal ranges for comparable LOI and pollen percentage panels.
# Charcoal uses separate ranges because the counting methods differ.
loi_max <- max(anne_loi$LOI, my_compare$LOI, na.rm = TRUE)
juniperus_max <- max(anne_compare$Juniperus, my_compare$Juniperus, na.rm = TRUE)
pinus_max <- max(anne_compare$Pinus, my_compare$Pinus, na.rm = TRUE)
anne_charcoal_max <- max(anne_compare$charcoal, na.rm = TRUE)
my_charcoal_max <- max(my_compare$charcoal, na.rm = TRUE)

panel_max <- c(
  "Anne LOI" = loi_max, "My LOI" = loi_max,
  "Anne charcoal" = anne_charcoal_max,
  "My charcoal" = my_charcoal_max,
  "Anne Juniperus" = juniperus_max, "My Juniperus" = juniperus_max,
  "Anne Pinus" = pinus_max, "My Pinus" = pinus_max
)

scale_limits <- data.frame(
  panel = rep(names(panel_max), each = 2),
  value = as.numeric(c(rbind(rep(0, length(panel_max)), panel_max))),
  age_cal_yr_BP = 0
)
scale_limits$panel <- factor(
  scale_limits$panel, levels = levels(comparison_age$panel)
)

core_comparison_age_plot <- ggplot(
  comparison_age,
  aes(x = value, y = age_cal_yr_BP)
) +
  geom_blank(data = scale_limits) +
  geom_line(orientation = "y", linewidth = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(size = 1.3, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_y_reverse(name = "Age (cal yr BP)") +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(panel), scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    title = "Trettetjørn core-to-core proxy comparison",
    subtitle = "Anne: original modelled ages | TRET25: Plum median ages"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

print(core_comparison_age_plot)
```

## Focused LOI and charcoal comparison

```{r}
#| label: fig-loi-charcoal-comparison
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7

loi_charcoal_long <- bind_rows(
  anne_loi |>
    transmute(age_cal_yr_BP, panel = "Bjune LOI", value = LOI),
  my_compare |>
    transmute(age_cal_yr_BP, panel = "My LOI", value = LOI),
  anne_compare |>
    transmute(age_cal_yr_BP, panel = "Bjune charcoal", value = charcoal),
  my_compare |>
    transmute(age_cal_yr_BP, panel = "My charcoal", value = charcoal)
) |>
  mutate(panel = factor(panel, levels = c(
    "Bjune LOI", "My LOI",
    "Bjune charcoal", "My charcoal"
  )))

loi_max_focus <- max(anne_loi$LOI, my_compare$LOI, na.rm = TRUE)
charcoal_max_bjune <- max(anne_compare$charcoal, na.rm = TRUE)
charcoal_max_tret <- max(my_compare$charcoal, na.rm = TRUE)

focus_panel_max <- c(
  "Bjune LOI" = loi_max_focus,
  "My LOI" = loi_max_focus,
  "Bjune charcoal" = charcoal_max_bjune,
  "My charcoal" = charcoal_max_tret
)

focus_limits <- data.frame(
  panel = factor(rep(names(focus_panel_max), each = 2),
                 levels = levels(loi_charcoal_long$panel)),
  value = as.numeric(rbind(rep(0, length(focus_panel_max)), focus_panel_max)),
  age_cal_yr_BP = 0
)

loi_charcoal_plot <- ggplot(loi_charcoal_long,
                           aes(x = value, y = age_cal_yr_BP)) +
  geom_blank(data = focus_limits) +
  geom_line(orientation = "y", linewidth = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_y_reverse(name = "Age (cal yr BP)") +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(panel), scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = NULL, title = "Trettetjørn: LOI and charcoal comparison",
       subtitle = "Bjune: original modelled ages | My core: Plum median ages") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

print(loi_charcoal_plot)
```
